# Time budgets for go test, read by internal/testtime.
#   leaf SECONDS                  a test that has no subtests
#   package PATH|default SECONDS  wall time of one package; PATH@JOB sets it for one job
#   test PATH NAME SECONDS        tests of PATH whose name starts with NAME
#   count PATH|default NAME MAX   largest count of servers, schemas or processes that the helpers start in PATH;
#                                 a package without a line and without a default has the limit 0
#   calibrate SECONDS             calibration time of the reference runner; testtime multiplies every time limit by
#                                 measured divided by this value, and never by less than 1
# CI runs go test -p 1, so each package is timed alone, not while other packages share the cores.
# A test with subtests is not checked, because a parallel parent reports the time of the whole package.
# A change that makes a test or package slower raises its number in the same diff and states why.
# A change that raises a count raises its line in the same diff and states why.

leaf 10
package default 10


# The git tests run the real git binary, and the contract tests start a PostgreSQL schema each.
package internal/server 20

# Measured on the ubuntu-latest go job; read the line "Calibration: ..." of that job to update it.
calibrate 0.037

# Each limit is the measured count plus a small margin. Servers and schemas are the contract tests, which start a
# server on a PostgreSQL schema or a SQLite file each. Processes are the git commands of the test helpers.
count internal/server servers 88
count internal/server schemas 55
count internal/server processes 155
count cmd/motte servers 1
count cmd/motte-loadtest servers 1
count meta/postgres schemas 46
count internal/vfs/ctl servers 20
count internal/vfs/ctl schemas 20
count internal/vfs/store servers 2
count internal/vfs/store schemas 2
count internal/vfs/importer processes 12
count internal/seams processes 2
